items.why: The fear gauge is jumping as the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq all drop ahead of a pivotal week for AI.
Motley Fool flags AMD sliding today as chip stocks fall with the Nasdaq while Nvidia drama continues to unfold.
Big tech is falling into a pivotal week for AI, with the Nasdaq dropping and warnings that the AI bubble will likely burst.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: Nasdaq futures are down about 1.7% and the S&P future is down about 1.1%, with oil slipping and the VIX up sharply.
summary: Stocks are sharply lower Monday midday, with the Nasdaq leading the slide as AI worries weigh on tech ahead of a pivotal week. The VIX is spiking as investors brace for Nvidia earnings and the Anthropic IPO.
